answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Proof of unique governance proposal authorship changes that arithmetic: a proposal voted on by a DAO over two years, so the trellis for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the marble is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the opal of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
